title: AVERAGE HEIGHT
subtitle: GIRLS · BY AGE
voice: High-energy TikTok fitness creator talking straight to camera: upbeat, punchy, fast, big smile in the voice, stress the key words, short snappy pauses.
intro: Average height for girls at every age. Find yours.

rows.say: Ten. Four six. Many girls start growing faster soon.
Twelve. Four eleven. Often the fastest year of growth.
Fourteen. Five three. Growth usually starts to slow down.
Sixteen. Five four. Most girls are close to their final height.
Eighteen. Five four. Pretty much final.

outro: And you? Comment your age and height.
